title: Reuse unchanged enriched session rows across test-run projection versions
outcome: Run updates in one session do not resend unchanged activity-enriched rows from unrelated running sessions; raw metadata recapture and removal of activity still emit changes.
acceptance: Across an updated test-run projection, retain an enriched session Arc only when its raw row Arc and derived activity are unchanged, using the existing enrichment cache owner.

A behavioral state-diff regression changes session A's run while session B's running activity and raw row stay unchanged; B is omitted, while recaptured raw metadata and removed activity remain observable.
